name: High-Precision Robotic Dispensing Machine
summary: Single-axis robot with multi-glue-gun matrix, positioning error ±0.2mm, single-line dispensing takes only 0.25 seconds. CAD drawings import seamlessly, one-click changeover.
contentHtml:
The high-precision robotic dispensing machine is a core piece of equipment developed by TXAM for precision coating processes.

Working Principle

It utilizes a single-axis robot combined with a multi-nozzle matrix, achieving fast and uniform dispensing through a precision motion control system. It supports direct import of CAD drawings and automatic generation of dispensing paths.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning error of only ±0.2mm, industry-leading precision
  • Dispensing speed of 0.25 seconds per line, extremely high efficiency
  • Supports one-click CAD drawing import for convenient changeovers
  • TCP/IP communication protocol, easy integration into smart factory systems

Model Description

The TX-NS-AGD-01 uses a fixture tray format, while the TX-NS-AGD-02 uses direct backplane feeding; the main difference lies in the production line compatibility method.
